area: Path coverage: the generic unknown-condition guard on every Path analyzer module, the Category lookup tab, and UCaaS one-click in the ZIA baseline and the Path analyzer
title: Unread rule conditions never match; Category lookup; UCaaS one-click

checks.what: Every field of the zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3 URL filtering, Cloud App Control, SSL inspection, File Type Control, Web DLP, Cloud Firewall, DNS, Sandbox, ATP settings and ZPA policy models is evaluated, neutral or a named unknown condition
A synthetic field no model has makes the rule's criterion unknown in every module, and the step conditional, never a definite match
Empty, false, zero, ANY and NONE values, and empty objects, set no condition
Category lookup reads only the policies in scope; nothing in scope is a 400 before a client is built
Rules naming a category are listed in evaluation order: admin rank first when on, the default rule last, disabled rules unnumbered
Every tenant and input value on the lookup page is escaped (node render and headless Chrome with a markup payload)
The lookup answer does not scroll the page sideways at 320 and 390 px; tabs work from the keyboard
UCaaS one-click: picked only explicitly, typed phrase whatever the count, re-plan and re-read before the write, whole object written back, read-back, Undo, conflicts left alone
Predefined one-click rules follow their switches in the Path analyzer: all off, no match; not read, nothing assumed

findings.title: A rule field the Path analyzer did not know (not on its named list of unevaluated conditions) was silently ignored, so a rule could be a definite match on a condition never checked
findings.fix: rule_fields.py lists per module the evaluated and neutral fields; any other non-empty field is an unknown criterion and the rule counts as could-apply

findings.title: ZIA settings toggles the ATP evaluator did not map, and ZPA rule fields outside the conditions, were ignored
findings.fix: An unknown ATP toggle that is on is an unknown block check; a ZPA rule with an unknown field is conditional

findings.title: The Cloud Firewall's excludeSrcCountries (a true or false switch) was shown as a condition 'Applies only to True'
findings.fix: It is the negation of sourceCountries: the source country criterion says 'Does not apply to' instead

findings.title: DNS Control left source IP conditions unknown even when the source address was given
findings.fix: DNS Control evaluates srcIps and IP source groups like the Cloud Firewall

findings.title: An SSL inspection rule whose only target is destination IP groups is never a candidate in the trace (ssl_flow matches categories and applications only)
findings.reason: The trace has no three-valued SSL match; the field is now named as an unknown criterion on such a rule, but the trace itself still treats the rule as not matching. Needs an 'unknown' SSL candidate state.

findings.title: Predefined UCaaS and Microsoft 365 one-click rules were matched without regard to the switch that turns them on
findings.fix: The switches are read with the Cloud Firewall; a predefined one-click rule whose switches are all off never matches

notes: Verified against zscaler-sdk-python 1.11.3: every rule model field (tests/test_rule_fields.py holds the lists and checks them against the installed SDK), url_filtering.get_url_and_app_settings / update_url_and_app_settings and the enableUcaasZoom, enableUcaasWebex, enableUcaasRingCentral, enableUcaasLogMeIn, enableUcaasTalkdesk and enableOffice365 fields.

Assumed: the predefined one-click rule names and app service group names (ZOOM, WEBEX, OFFICE365, ...); that a switch turned off stops ZIA applying its predefined rule; restrictionType on ZPA rules being metadata; the tier defaults for UCaaS one-click (on for all but Strict).
App service group matching by domain and address is another branch's work; appServiceGroups stays a named unknown condition here.
